description:
We are a team of passionate students and builders interested in AI, software development, space technology, data science, UI/UX, and creative problem-solving. For NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026, we are building Moonbase Commander, an interactive lunar survival and learning game that helps young students understand the real challenges of managing a Moon base.

Our goal is to combine science, technology, storytelling, and game design to create an experience that is both educational and engaging. We enjoy turning complex ideas into simple, interactive experiences and using NASA data to make our project scientifically grounded.

We are looking for teammates who are interested in:

Game development / frontend development

UI/UX and visual design

NASA/space science and research

Data analysis and simulation

Game mechanics and systems design

Video production, storytelling, and presentation

Testing and educational content
